```{python}
def download(url, filename):
    r = requests.get(url)
    with open(filename, "wb") as f:
        f.write(r.content)

def unzip(zip_path, extract_to):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, "r") as z:
        z.extractall(extract_to)

files = {
    "training1.zip": "https://github.com/byui-cse/cse450-course/raw/master/data/roadsigns/training1.zip",
    "training2.zip": "https://github.com/byui-cse/cse450-course/raw/master/data/roadsigns/training2.zip",
    "holdout.zip":   "https://github.com/byui-cse/cse450-course/raw/master/data/roadsigns/holdout.zip",
    "mini_holdout.zip": "https://github.com/byui-cse/cse450-course/raw/master/data/roadsigns/mini_holdout.zip",
    "mini_holdout_answers.csv": "https://github.com/byui-cse/cse450-course/raw/master/data/roadsigns/mini_holdout_answers.csv"
}

for filename, url in files.items():
    download(url, f"data/{filename}")

unzip("data/training1.zip", "data")
unzip("data/training2.zip", "data")
unzip("data/holdout.zip", "data")
unzip("data/mini_holdout.zip", "data")

# Merge training folders
os.makedirs("data/training", exist_ok=True)
for folder in ["data/training1", "data/training2"]:
    if os.path.exists(folder):
        for cls in os.listdir(folder):
            src = os.path.join(folder, cls)
            dst = os.path.join("data/training", cls)
            os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
            for f in os.listdir(src):
                shutil.move(os.path.join(src, f), os.path.join(dst, f))

# Cleanup
for f in ["training1.zip", "training2.zip", "holdout.zip", "mini_holdout.zip"]:
    fp = f"data/{f}"
    if os.path.exists(fp):
        os.remove(fp)

shutil.rmtree("data/training1", ignore_errors=True)
shutil.rmtree("data/training2", ignore_errors=True)

print("Data ready.")
```

```{python}
class RoadSignDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, root, img_size, transform=None):
        self.root = root
        self.img_size = img_size
        self.transform = transform
        self.samples = []

        for class_name in sorted(os.listdir(root)):
            class_path = os.path.join(root, class_name)
            if not os.path.isdir(class_path):
                continue
            label = int(class_name)
            for f in os.listdir(class_path):
                if f.lower().endswith((".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg")):
                    self.samples.append((os.path.join(class_path, f), label))

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.samples)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        path, label = self.samples[idx]
        img = Image.open(path).convert("RGB")
        img = img.resize(self.img_size)

        img = np.array(img)

        if self.transform:
            img = self.transform(img)
        else:
            img = torch.tensor(img / 255.0, dtype=torch.float32).permute(2, 0, 1)

        return img, label


from torchvision import transforms

# -----------------------------
# 1. Define transforms
# -----------------------------
train_transform = transforms.Compose([
    transforms.ToPILImage(),
    transforms.RandomRotation(10),
    transforms.ColorJitter(brightness=0.2, contrast=0.2),
    transforms.RandomAffine(0, translate=(0.05, 0.05)),
    transforms.Resize(config["img_size"]),   # ⭐ FIX
    transforms.ToTensor()
])

val_transform = transforms.Compose([
    transforms.ToPILImage(),
    transforms.Resize(config["img_size"]),   # ⭐ FIX
    transforms.ToTensor()
])


# -----------------------------
# 2. Create two dataset objects
# -----------------------------
train_dataset = RoadSignDataset("data/training", config["img_size"], transform=train_transform)
val_dataset   = RoadSignDataset("data/training", config["img_size"], transform=val_transform)

# -----------------------------
# 3. Split indices ONCE
# -----------------------------
train_size = int(0.8 * len(train_dataset))
val_size = len(train_dataset) - train_size

train_ds, val_ds_indices = torch.utils.data.random_split(train_dataset, [train_size, val_size])

# Replace val_ds with a Subset of val_dataset using the SAME indices
val_ds = torch.utils.data.Subset(val_dataset, val_ds_indices.indices)

# -----------------------------
# 4. Create loaders
# -----------------------------
train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=config["batch_size"], shuffle=True)
val_loader   = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=config["batch_size"], shuffle=False)

print("Train batches:", len(train_loader), "Val batches:", len(val_loader))



train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=config["batch_size"], shuffle=True)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=config["batch_size"], shuffle=False)

print("Train batches:", len(train_loader), "Val batches:", len(val_loader))

```


```{python}
class CNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.features = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(3, 32, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 32, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),

            nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),

            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Flatten(),
            nn.Linear(8192, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, num_classes)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.classifier(self.features(x))

model = CNN(config["num_classes"]).to(device)
criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=config["learning_rate"])

```


```{python}
train_acc_history = []
val_acc_history = []
train_loss_history = []
val_loss_history = []

best_val_acc = 0.0
best_settings = {}

for epoch in range(config["epochs"]):
    start = time.time()

    # Training
    model.train()
    total, correct, running_loss = 0, 0, 0.0

    for images, labels in train_loader:
        images, labels = images.to(device), labels.to(device)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(images)
        loss = criterion(outputs, labels)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()

        running_loss += loss.item()
        _, preds = torch.max(outputs, 1)
        correct += (preds == labels).sum().item()
        total += labels.size(0)

    train_acc = correct / total
    train_loss = running_loss / len(train_loader)

    # Validation
    model.eval()
    total, correct, val_loss_sum = 0, 0, 0.0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for images, labels in val_loader:
            images, labels = images.to(device), labels.to(device)
            outputs = model(images)
            loss = criterion(outputs, labels)
            val_loss_sum += loss.item()
            _, preds = torch.max(outputs, 1)
            correct += (preds == labels).sum().item()
            total += labels.size(0)

    val_acc = correct / total
    val_loss = val_loss_sum / len(val_loader)

    # Save best model
    if val_acc > best_val_acc:
        best_val_acc = val_acc
        best_settings = {
            "epoch": epoch + 1,
            "train_acc": train_acc,
            "val_acc": val_acc,
            "train_loss": train_loss,
            "val_loss": val_loss,
            "config": config.copy()
        }
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pt")
        print(f"🔥 Saved NEW best model at epoch {epoch+1} (val_acc={val_acc:.4f})")

    train_acc_history.append(train_acc)
    val_acc_history.append(val_acc)
    train_loss_history.append(train_loss)
    val_loss_history.append(val_loss)

    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{config['epochs']}  Train Acc: {train_acc:.4f}  Val Acc: {val_acc:.4f}  Time: {time.time()-start:.2f}s")

print("\n🏆 Best Model Summary:")
for k, v in best_settings.items():
    print(f"{k}: {v}")
```

```{python}
def load_holdout(path, img_size):
    imgs, names = [], []
    for f in sorted(os.listdir(path)):
        if f.lower().endswith((".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg")):
            img = Image.open(os.path.join(path, f)).convert("RGB")
            img = img.resize(img_size)
            img = torch.tensor(np.array(img)/255.0, dtype=torch.float32).permute(2,0,1)
            imgs.append(img)
            names.append(f)
    return torch.stack(imgs), names

# Load best model
best_model = CNN(config["num_classes"]).to(device)
best_model.load_state_dict(torch.load("best_model.pt", map_location=device))
best_model.eval()

# Mini holdout
mini_imgs, mini_names = load_holdout("data/mini_holdout", config["img_size"])
mini_imgs = mini_imgs.to(device)

answers = pd.read_csv("data/mini_holdout_answers.csv")
true_labels = answers["ClassId"].values

with torch.no_grad():
    preds = torch.argmax(best_model(mini_imgs), dim=1).cpu().numpy()

holdout_acc = (preds == true_labels).mean()
print(f"📊 Mini Holdout Accuracy: {holdout_acc:.4f}")
```

```{python}
from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score, f1_score,
    classification_report, confusion_matrix
)
import seaborn as sns

# -----------------------------
# Load best model
# -----------------------------
best_model = CNN(config["num_classes"]).to(device)
best_model.load_state_dict(torch.load("best_model.pt", map_location=device))
best_model.eval()

# ============================================================
# 1. VALIDATION SET METRICS
# ============================================================
all_preds = []
all_labels = []

with torch.no_grad():
    for images, labels in val_loader:
        images, labels = images.to(device), labels.to(device)
        outputs = best_model(images)
        preds = torch.argmax(outputs, dim=1)
        all_preds.extend(preds.cpu().numpy())
        all_labels.extend(labels.cpu().numpy())

all_preds = np.array(all_preds)
all_labels = np.array(all_labels)

print("\n==============================")
print("📊 VALIDATION SET METRICS")
print("==============================")
print("Accuracy:", accuracy_score(all_labels, all_preds))
print("Precision (macro):", precision_score(all_labels, all_preds, average="macro"))
print("Recall (macro):", recall_score(all_labels, all_preds, average="macro"))
print("F1 (macro):", f1_score(all_labels, all_preds, average="macro"))
print("\nFull Classification Report:")
print(classification_report(all_labels, all_preds))

# Confusion matrix
cm_val = confusion_matrix(all_labels, all_preds)
plt.figure(figsize=(10,8))
sns.heatmap(cm_val, cmap="Blues")
plt.title("Validation Confusion Matrix")
plt.xlabel("Predicted")
plt.ylabel("True")
plt.show()

# ============================================================
# 2. MINI HOLDOUT METRICS
# ============================================================
mini_imgs, mini_names = load_holdout("data/mini_holdout", config["img_size"])
mini_imgs = mini_imgs.to(device)

answers = pd.read_csv("data/mini_holdout_answers.csv")
true_labels = answers["ClassId"].values

with torch.no_grad():
    preds = torch.argmax(best_model(mini_imgs), dim=1).cpu().numpy()

print("\n==============================")
print("📊 MINI HOLDOUT METRICS")
print("==============================")
print("Accuracy:", accuracy_score(true_labels, preds))
print("Precision (macro):", precision_score(true_labels, preds, average="macro"))
print("Recall (macro):", recall_score(true_labels, preds, average="macro"))
print("F1 (macro):", f1_score(true_labels, preds, average="macro"))
print("\nFull Classification Report:")
print(classification_report(true_labels, preds))

# Confusion matrix
cm_holdout = confusion_matrix(true_labels, preds)
plt.figure(figsize=(10,8))
sns.heatmap(cm_holdout, cmap="Blues")
plt.title("Mini Holdout Confusion Matrix")
plt.xlabel("Predicted")
plt.ylabel("True")
plt.show()

# Per-class accuracy
print("\n📊 Per-Class Accuracy:")
for cls in np.unique(true_labels):
    idx = true_labels == cls
    acc = (preds[idx] == true_labels[idx]).mean()
    print(f"Class {cls}: {acc:.4f}")
```
